description_en: Queries the endpoint group information of a specified basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
description_zh: 调用GetBasicEndpointGroup接口查询指定基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组信息
kebab_example: aliyun ga get-basic-endpoint-group --biz-region-id cn-hangzhou --endpoint-group-id epg-bp1dmlohjjz4kqaun0000 --region cn-hangzhou
name: GetBasicEndpointGroup

parameters.help_en: The region ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance. Only cn-hangzhou is supported
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例所在的地域ID，仅取值cn-hangzhou
parameters.name: region_id

parameters.help_en:
The client token that is used to ensure the idempotence of the request.

You can use the client to generate the value, but you must make sure that the value is unique among different requests. The client token can contain only ASCII characters.

If you do not specify this parameter, the system automatically uses the RequestId of the API request as the ClientToken. The RequestId of each API request is unique
parameters.help_zh:
客户端Token，用于保证请求的幂等性。

从您的客户端生成一个参数值，确保不同请求间该参数值唯一。ClientToken只支持ASCII字符。

若您未指定，则系统自动使用API请求的RequestId作为ClientToken标识。每次API请求的RequestId不一样
parameters.name: client_token

parameters.help_en: The ID of the endpoint group of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
parameters.help_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组ID
parameters.name: endpoint_group_id

AcceleratorId.description_en: The instance ID of the basic Global Accelerator (GA)

Description.description_en: The description of the endpoint group of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
Description.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组描述信息

EndpointGroupId.description_en: The ID of the endpoint group of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
EndpointGroupId.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组ID

EndpointGroupRegion.description_en: The region ID of the endpoint group of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
EndpointGroupRegion.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组所在的地域ID

EndpointSubAddress.description_en:
The secondary address of the endpoint.

This parameter is returned when the endpoint type is ECS, ENI, or NLB.
When the endpoint type is ECS, EndpointSubAddress is the secondary private IP or the primary private IP of the primary network interface controller (NIC).
When the endpoint type is ENI, EndpointSubAddress is the secondary private IP or the primary private IP of the secondary network interface controller (NIC).
When the endpoint type is NLB, EndpointSubAddress is the primary private IP of the NLB backend server
EndpointSubAddress.description_zh:
终端节点辅助地址。

当终端节点类型为ECS、ENI或NLB时，返回该参数。
当终端节点类型为ECS时，EndpointSubAddress为主网卡的辅助私网IP或主网卡的主私网IP。
当终端节点类型为ENI时，EndpointSubAddress为辅助网卡的辅助私网IP或辅助网卡的主私网IP。
当终端节点类型为NLB时，EndpointSubAddress为NLB后端服务器的主私网IP

EndpointType.description_en:
The endpoint type. Valid values:
ENI: Alibaba Cloud elastic network interface controller (NIC).
SLB: Alibaba Cloud Classic Load Balancer (CLB) instance.
ECS: Alibaba Cloud ECS instance.
NLB: Alibaba Cloud Network Load Balancer (NLB) instance
EndpointType.description_zh:
终端节点类型。
ENI：阿里云弹性网卡。
SLB：阿里云CLB实例。
ECS：阿里云ECS实例。
NLB：阿里云NLB实例

Name.description_en: The name of the endpoint group of the basic Global Accelerator (GA) instance
Name.description_zh: 基础型全球加速实例的终端节点组的名称
